title: Snap installation - Godot crashes when opening file in vscode - 4.6.1-mono-ubuntu-snap
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e] (snap) Snap installation from - Not reproducable in v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e] (from the site, not snap) - Not reproducable in v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] (from the site, not snap) ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Ubuntu Core 24 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Graphics (RPL-P) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13420H (12 threads) - 31.04 GiB memory ### Issue description I open either my own project or a new one (and add a gd file to it), and try to open a gd file in vscode, and godot crahes. I don't see a zombie process left behind, but I'm not 100% sure (I say it since another issue mentioned that). My modified settings are: Running `godot-4 --verbose`: ``` guy@hometown:~$ godot-4 --verbose WorkerThreadPool: 12 threads, 3 max low-priority. I don't exactly remember if the following behaviors were present in this specific repro, but: - Sometimes the line "Loading resource: res://foo.gd" would appear after the editor loaded, before clicking, and with no error attached. I think this is because godot remembers it was selected and starts up with it selected, but it doesn't actually try to open it yet. - Sometimes the editor doesn't crash, but still gives the crash message shown here (or a similar one) when I exit it.
